decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions and due to the appropriate location and design of the part two-storey part single-storey rear extension, the proposal would not be harmful to the appearance of the house or the street scene and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is therefore consistent with the adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines. Where it varies from the guidelines not material harm would result.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of part single storey part two-storey rear extension to house.
